meta.repo_stats_note: repo helpers `proportion_z_test` / `mann_whitney_u` (brier/experiments/analyze.py) return bucketed p-values (0.001/0.01/0.05/0.10/0.20), not exact ones
meta.normalisation: CRPS normalised by the SD of the unit's own supplied 60-month history from ground_truth.json (frozen at pre-registration). NEVER by the model's own interval width.
meta.plausibility_note: A parsed forecast is flagged `implausible_extraction` when its point OR either interval endpoint falls outside [0.1x, 10x] the unit's last observed history value. This band is deliberately loose (a state SNAP caseload cannot move 10-fold in 30 months). It exists to separate an extraction artefact from a forecast, not to filter forecasts by quality.
